text_block_list.text: On the day of the Spring Stakes――

"Normally, a prep race leading up to the 
big stage would have the crowd buzzing 
with excitement, but..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait... F-Five people!? Isn't that the 
bare minimum needed for a race!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's a race with over ten runners every 
single year, you know?! And despite 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, up until today, I thought 
having only five competitors was just a 
lie, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... There really were five of them.

Her sheer presence is likely why the other 
Umamusume avoided the race, but—
choice_data_list: Let's focus on the race for now.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a race, I gotta have fun with 
it! Alright, focus, focus!
